name: RACF - Users with Sensitive FACILITY Access

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) WHERE res.name IN ['BPX.SUPERUSER', 'BPX.DAEMON', 'IRR.PASSWORD.RESET', 'IRR.LISTUSER', 'RACF.SETROPTS.STATISTICS'] OR res.name STARTS WITH 'IRR.RADMIN' OR res.name STARTS WITH 'STGADMIN' OR res.name STARTS WITH 'MVSADMIN' RETURN u, r, res ORDER BY res.name
